meta.name: computer-use-agents
meta.description: Build AI agents that interact with computers like humans do - viewing screens, moving cursors, clicking buttons, and typing text. Covers Anthropic's Computer Use, OpenAI's Operator/CUA, and open-source alternatives. Critical focus on sandboxing, security, and handling the unique challenges of vision-based control. Use when: computer use, desktop automation agent, screen control AI, vision-based agent, GUI automation.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能像人类一样操作电脑：看屏幕、移动鼠标、点击按钮、输入文字。
howto.when: 当你提到“电脑操作”、“桌面自动化”、“屏幕控制”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开计算器并计算 123*456。
say.note: Claude 会移动鼠标点击计算器并执行运算。

say.text: 截图并告诉我右下角显示的时间。
say.note: Claude 会截取屏幕并分析图像。

say.text: 在浏览器中搜索明天的天气。
say.note: Claude 会打开浏览器、输入搜索并返回结果。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to interact with computers like a human: view screen, move cursor, click buttons, and type text.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'computer use', 'desktop automation', 'screen control', etc.

say_en.note: Claude will move the mouse and perform the calculation.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot and tell me the time in the bottom right.
say_en.note: Claude will capture and analyze the screen.

say_en.text: Search for tomorrow's weather in a browser.
say_en.note: Claude will open browser, type query, and return results.
